main.description: Start a public-only business person role collection run for officers, directors, registered agents, board memberships, and affiliations from official filings, registries, and corporate leadership pages.

sourceId.description: Public source family such as edinet, gbizinfo, sec-edgar, companies-house, handelsregister, or corporate-hp.

sourceUrl.description: Optional official filing, registry, or corporate leadership URL.

format.description: Source format, for example xbrl, registryApi, filingHtml, or corporateHp.

fetch.description: When true, fetch sourceUrl before deterministic extraction. Defaults to true in the worker.

timeoutSec.description: HTTP fetch timeout for public source retrieval.

cursor.description: Optional source cursor, page token, or start index.

pageSize.description: Source page size for paginated registry fetches.

pagesFetched.description: Number of source pages fetched in this workflow instance.

maxPages.description: Maximum source pages to fetch before handing off to the scheduler.

nextSourceUrl.description: Prepared URL for the next source page, if any.

hasNextPage.description: Whether a follow-up source page should be scheduled.

htmlText.description: Optional already-fetched corporate leadership page HTML for deterministic extraction.

text.description: Optional already-fetched plain text from a public source.

orgName.description: Fallback organization name for rows extracted from corporate leadership pages.

companiesHouseJson.description: Optional already-fetched Companies House officers JSON response.

companyNumber.description: Companies House company number when parsing officers JSON.

corporateNumber.description: Japanese corporate number when building or parsing gBizINFO requests.

gbizInfoJson.description: Optional already-fetched gBizINFO corporate JSON response.

docId.description: EDINET document ID when building or parsing EDINET document requests.

edinetJson.description: Optional already-fetched EDINET document metadata or extracted filing JSON.

secEdgarJson.description: Optional already-fetched SEC EDGAR submissions, ownership, or filing-derived JSON.

cik.description: SEC CIK when parsing EDGAR officer records.

handelsregisterJson.description: Optional already-fetched Handelsregister officer or company entry JSON.

registerNumber.description: Handelsregister register number when parsing German registry officer records.

rows.description: Optional already-fetched public role rows for deterministic smoke runs.
